description: Analyzes the blast radius and coupling of files to prevent breaking changes. This tool reveals which other files are frequently co-committed with the target file, helping you understand what else might be affected by your changes. Use cases: bug fixes, feature additions, refactoring, code review.

file_path.description: Path to the file to analyze, relative to repo root

repo_root.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

name: get_impact_analysis
